title: Jobsy SMP
description: An economy-driven Lifesteal server featuring jobs, duels, manhunts, coin flips, tic-tac-toe, player shops, and more. Earn money, steal hearts
body:
**🌍 Jobsy SMP
A unique economy-based Lifesteal SMP where every heart matters! Earn money through jobs, challenge players to duels, join exciting manhunts, and test your luck in games like coin flips and tic-tac-toe. Build your wealth, dominate PvP, and become the richest and strongest player on the server.**
